reason: I already have my Toplux and I reorder it when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. Magnesium is not something I was shopping for, I would just scroll past it.
objection: Is it really tested, or just marketing? A lab report on a page is nice, but I have no way to know it's real, and I don't know this brand.
would_change_my_mind: If it was a lot cheaper for a first try, or someone I follow showed the lab report and used it for a few weeks, I might try one box.
